name: Uchitani Mika no Jouai -Jikan Kanshou Ryokou no Shoujo-tachi No.2-
original_name: 内谷観香の情愛ー時間感傷旅行の少女たち Ｎｏ．2ー
source:
While I work in terrible human relationships and under a badass boss, 
a girl appears in front of me saying "I'm with you." What is her true identity?
A pure love novel game themed on "Naikan Therapy".

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE233707.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当我在糟糕的人际关系和坏老板的领导下工作时，
一个女孩出现在我面前说“我和你在一起”。她的真实身份是什么？
一款以“内观疗法”为主题的纯爱小说游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE233707.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
